in_marathi.name: Niteen
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Shiva, Youthful, Radiant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Niteen हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Niteen is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Nit' meaning new, young or youthful, and 'Teen' meaning Lord Shiva. This name evokes the image of a young and radiant Lord Shiva. Niteen is believed to bring prosperity, strength, and good fortune to the bearer.
